blocks.arabic_text: فَعَيَّرْتُهُ بِأُمِّهِ، فَقَالَ لِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: يَا اَبَا ذَرٍّ! اَعَيَّرْتَهُ بِأُمِّهِ؟ اِنَّكَ امْرَؤٌ فِيْكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ، اِخْوَانُكُمْ خَوَلُكُمْ جَعَلَهُمُ اللهُ تَحْتَ اَيْدِيْكُمْ، فَمَنْ كَانَ اَخُوْهُ تَحْتَ يَدِهِ فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ، وَلْيُلْبِسْهُ مِمَّا يَلْبَسُ، وَلَا تُكَلِّفُوْهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوْهُمْ فَأَعِيْنُوْهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب المعاصي من امر الجاهلية....، رقم:٣٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ma'rur (RH) says: “When I met Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) at a place called “Rabadhah”, he and his slave were wearing the same kind of garments. (I said,) There is no difference at all between your clothes and your slave's clothes! I asked him, “What is the reason?” (He said,) “Once I abused my slave; I provoked him by abusing his mother. This news reached Rasulullah ﷺ. (He said,) “O Abu Dharr, did you abuse him and provoke him by (abusing) his mother? The habit of the time of ignorance still dwells in you. Your slaves are your brothers! Allah Ta'ala has placed them under your authority. Therefore, whoever has a slave as his brother, let him give him to eat of what he himself eats, and give him to wear of what he himself wears; do not burden them with heavy work, and if you entrust them with difficult work, help them,” — Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) told me that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: مَا سُئِلَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ: لَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب في سخائه ﷺ، رقم: ٦٠١٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “It never once happened that the Prophet ﷺ was asked for something and the Prophet ﷺ refused it,” —
